metricas.title: Portal Metrics
metricas.subtitle: Last {{dias}} days · Querétaro Plant
metricas.deflexion_ayuda: Incidents resolved without IT stepping in.
metricas.tiempo_ayuda: Only tickets handled by a technician.
metricas.normalizados_ayuda: Share of tickets Ollama managed to rewrite.
metricas.utilidad_ayuda: Suggestions marked useful out of those shown. This is what calibrates the threshold.
metricas.umbral_ayuda: Too low suggests noise; too high almost never suggests.
metricas.pendientes_ayuda: Closed with a solution Ollama has not processed yet. reindexar_kb.py picks them up.
metricas.precision_ayuda: Detected category vs. the final one. Over {{n}} comparable cases.
metricas.ollama_caido: Ollama is not responding. The portal works the same, just without AI assistance.
metricas.latencia_nota: Latencies are for this process since last restart, not a historical series.

usuarios.title: People
usuarios.subtitle: Who has access, in what state, and what they are accountable for.
usuarios.nota_flujo: Creating the account generates a single-use code. Hand it to the person: they use it to set their own password, which IT never knows. If you fill in the date of birth, they can also activate on their own with it, no code needed. And if they remember nothing, use “Activate here” with the person present.
usuarios.buscar: Search by name, email or department...
usuarios.confirmar_restablecer: Reset the password for {{nombre}}? Their current password will stop working and they will create a new one with the code generated.
usuarios.codigo_unica_vez: This code is shown only once.
usuarios.error_alta: The person could not be added.
usuarios.error_accion: The operation could not be completed.
usuarios.error_documento: The document could not be generated.
usuarios.numero_empleado_ayuda: This is how they sign in. It must match the badge.
usuarios.fecha_ingreso_ayuda: Alternative to date of birth. Many people do not remember it.
usuarios.numero_provisional: Placeholder number · set the real one
usuarios.asistida_ayuda: Activate the account with the person present: they type their own password.
usuarios.asistida_entregue: Hand the keyboard to the person.
usuarios.asistida_nota: They type the password. You will not see it and cannot recover it later.
usuarios.no_coinciden: The two passwords do not match
usuarios.solo_asistida_ayuda: Cannot self-activate: needs a code or activation at the desk.
usuarios.fecha_nacimiento_ayuda: Lets them activate on their own, with no code. It is the date people actually remember.
usuarios.asistida_lista: Account activated. They can now sign in with their number and that password.
usuarios.numero_epp_ayuda: The four digits they use to collect their equipment. Together with the date of birth, it lets them activate on their own.
usuarios.un_factor_ayuda: Will activate with a single detail. Ask HR for their PPE number so two can be required.

importar.title: Import staff
importar.subtitle: Register the whole plant from one file instead of one person at a time.
importar.elegir: Drop the CSV file here, or click to choose it
importar.columnas_minimas: Bare minimum: employee number and name. Email and start date are optional.
importar.filas_con_problema: Rows that will not be imported
importar.nota_errores: Rows with problems are skipped; the rest are imported.
importar.como_activan: How will people sign in the first time?
importar.modo_codigo_detalle: A single-use code for each person. They have to be handed out.
importar.modo_verificacion: With their number and a date they know
importar.modo_verificacion_detalle: Nothing to hand out: each person identifies with data they already know.
importar.faltan_fechas: {{n}} person(s) are missing that date. In this mode the whole file is rejected.
importar.codigos_unica_vez: Codes are shown only once. If you close this screen without downloading them, they must be regenerated one by one.
importar.sin_codigos_titulo: There are no codes to hand out.
importar.sin_codigos_detalle: Each person signs in with their employee number and start date.
importar.error_analizar: The file could not be read.
importar.error_importar: The import could not be completed.
importar.mapeo_titulo: Tell us which column is which
importar.mapeo_detalle: The file has headers we did not recognise. Match each field to its column and carry on; nothing needs reformatting in Excel.
importar.mapeo_sugerido: The portal proposed a match. Review it: the final say is yours.
importar.mapeo_faltan: The columns marked * still need to be set.
importar.que_dato: Which detail may no one be missing?
importar.por_que_nacimiento: On activation each person is asked for the two details they actually remember: their PPE number and their date of birth. Here you choose which of them must be complete in the file; if any row is missing it, the whole file is rejected. The number in the pill is how many people would be left without that detail.
importar.repartir_detalle: Download one file per area and give it to each supervisor, so distribution does not all land on IT.

soluciones.title: General solutions
soluciones.subtitle: Ten tickets about the same fault leave ten similar solutions and none of them complete. Here what was learned is gathered into one procedure: what to check first, what it usually is, and what has already been ruled out.
